title: Mid-quarter spend triage 1:1 notes
agenda: Quick state: run-rate delta vs goal
Flagged vendors / PO approvals needing decision
Tradeoffs: push vs approve vs re-scope
Short-term mitigations (30/60 day) to reduce burn
quick_numbers: Projected overspend this quarter: ~$270k–420k depending on infra delta
body:
Notes to self before 1:1 with Marco — keep this tight.

Context: mid-quarter review, need quick triage on a handful of procurement items and infra spend anomalies. Recent increases mostly infra (experimental GPU bursts), one new SaaS vendor (AnalyzeAI) invoice that doubled month-over-month. Goal is to land on 2–3 concrete mitigations to hold run-rate to <+3% by end of quarter, and decisions for any spend >$50k.

Observations / hypotheses:
- Serving infra: spike on Feb 4–10 from load test + experiments; some sustained higher baseline from Dedicated smoke tests. Need to confirm whether costs are one-offs (testing) or new baseline (config drift).
- Quantization licensing: renewed at higher tier due to multi-node tests — can we revert to single-node for prod path?
- New vendor AnalyzeAI: vendor onboarding slipped; contract auto-renew clause may have triggered higher price. Legal asked for cancellation window check.
- PCI spending: small but steady increase tied to log retention; retention policy review may yield quick wins.

Questions to ask Marco in the 1:1:
- Which infra experiments do we want to keep vs roll back? (prioritize predictable costs over exploratory tests)
- Do we have runway to absorb AnalyzeAI + Nimbus burst until next invoicing, or need immediate stop/gap?
- Approvals: Any PO > $75k that we push back will require sales/eng alignment — are we ready to take that hit?

Decision heuristics I'm leaning to (prep):
- Any recurring vendor with >10% month-over-month increase -> hold spend and request justification OR renegotiate within 14 days.
- One-off spikes tied to testing -> tag as "testing" and bill to R&D with cost cap.
- For vendor contracts with auto-renewal, check cancellation windows immediately; if within window, pause renewal and ask for short-term credit while we assess.

Meeting tone: pragmatic, give Marco options (approve with conditions, defer with plan, or deny). Aim to leave with clear owners and due dates.

Scratch checklist (things to pull before meeting):
- Updated Spend dashboard (last 30/90/365 days) — refresh & screenshot
- Vendor list with M/M delta and contract renewal dates (highlight >10% change)
- Top 5 cost drivers by category (infra, licensing, R&D experiments, logs/observability, third-party APIs)
- Current PO status table (amount, approver, due by)

Notes on tone and phrasing for approvals: keep approvals conditional. Example: "Approve Nimbus burst for Q1 with cap $60k and auto-shutdown policy; finance to review usage weekly and revoke if baseline >$35k/month."

Loose ideas for mitigations (rapid):
- Apply shorter log retention for non-prod: drop 60% of logs older than 14 days -> est savings $18k/month
- Pause non-essential auto-scale policies for Dedicated pools overnight -> est savings $12k/month
- Negotiate AnalyzeAI trial credits or downgrade to essential tier: ask for 30-day credit to align next invoice -> low friction

Unresolved / followups I want from Marco:
- Confirm whether infra team can tag testing traffic immediately (owner: EngInfra)
- OK to open negotiation thread with AnalyzeAI (owner: Marco or Solutions Eng?)
- Decision threshold for approving any new committed capacity (>3 months) — do we escalate to execs?

Tone reminders to self during meeting: keep it short, prioritize decisions that unblock near-term savings, avoid micromanaging engineering implementation details unless necessary.
action_items: Aisha: pull last-90-day vendor M/M delta table and highlight top 10 by delta — due 2026-03-12
Marco: confirm cancellation window for AnalyzeAI and request credits — due 2026-03-14
Liam (EngInfra): tag Feb test traffic and add 'test' cost center to those runs; report by 2026-03-13
FinanceOps: prepare conditional approval template for PO < $75k and > $75k — due 2026-03-15
Legal: validate auto-renew clause language for top 3 vendors (AnalyzeAI, Nimbus Cloud GPU, QuantEdge) — due 2026-03-16
